objective.text: Recognize that a whole-store flush may remove entries beyond an application's configured prefix.

difficulty.rationale: Recognize that a naming prefix is not an isolation boundary for a whole-store flush.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: Two applications use different Laravel cache prefixes but share a Redis logical database. One runs Cache::flush(). Why is the other application’s cache at risk?

options.text: The risk applies only if the applications generated an identical individual key.
options.rationale: Whole-database flushing can remove distinct prefixed keys as well.
options.misconception: Whole-database flushing can remove distinct prefixed keys as well.

options.text: Different prefixes are merged only when both applications use the same APP_NAME.
options.rationale: APP_NAME does not make flushdb selectively respect prefixes.
options.misconception: APP_NAME does not make flushdb selectively respect prefixes.

options.text: The Redis store flush clears the database rather than restricting deletion to that prefix.
options.rationale: A prefix helps namespace ordinary keys, but this whole-store operation uses flushdb.

options.text: Laravel automatically synchronizes all prefixed keys whenever one key is removed.
options.rationale: Ordinary single-key removal is not the broad operation described here.
options.misconception: Ordinary single-key removal is not the broad operation described here.
